data.one_liner: Collection of extensions for handling null types in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides utility extension methods and functions to work with nullable types, collections, maps, and futures in Dart, enabling cleaner null-checking and error handling.
use_when: You want concise extension methods for safe handling of nullable values, strings, lists, and maps.
You need functional-style operations like letNonNull or mapNonNull on nullable collections.
avoid_when: You prefer standard Dart null-aware operators without adding third-party extension libraries.
strengths: Simplifies working with nullable types and collections.
Provides intuitive helper extensions like isNullOrEmpty, orZero, and mapNonNull.
weaknesses: Adds an external dependency for features largely covered by standard Dart null safety features.
Documentation outside the README is minimal.
